decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to create a combo using Goblins to sacrifice creatures and generate mana, while also utilizing spells and artifacts to draw cards and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to quickly assemble pieces to either overwhelm the opponent with Goblin tokens or utilize a combo finish with cards such as Deadly Dispute and Impulsive Pilferer. The deck also includes removal spells like Duress to control the board and protect its own combo pieces.

This deck focuses on using gates to control the game by countering spells and removing threats from the board. It includes a mix of creature removal, card draw, and protection spells to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key strategy is to set up efficient defense with gates and counterspells, while gradually gaining advantage through card advantage and creatures with flying. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and eventually win through attrition and strategic plays.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tolarian Terror, paired with efficient card draw and counter spells to control the game. Additionally, it includes bounce spells like Boomerang to disrupt opponents' plays and tempo. The goal is to apply early pressure with creatures and protect them with countermagic while maintaining card advantage through card draw. The inclusion of cards like Lórien Revealed and Cryptic Serpent provide additional threats and finishers to close out the game quickly.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tolarian Terror, while utilizing spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures and powerful counterspells, while also drawing cards and generating tempo advantage with spells like Brainstorm and Boomerang. By efficiently managing resources and applying constant pressure, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory in the Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal while generating card advantage through card draw and bounce effects. It aims to control the game by efficiently dealing with threats and establishing its own win conditions gradually. The deck utilizes a combination of creatures with disruptive abilities, card draw spells, and removal to outvalue opponents and secure the win. It relies on a mix of tempo plays and grinding out advantage to maintain control over the game and ultimately come out ahead.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures using cards like Acorn Harvest and Satyr Wayfinder, then using Exhume and Dread Return to reanimate powerful creatures like Lotleth Giant and Scrapwork Mutt. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced combo strategy, utilizing the graveyard as a resource to bring back powerful threats like Rubblebelt Maverick and Stinkweed Imp. By efficiently utilizing the graveyard and carefully timing reanimation spells, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The foundation of the deck lies in aggressive creatures such as Boarding Party and Annoyed Altisaur, backed up by mana ramp in Arbor Elf and Utopia Sprawl. By quickly deploying creatures and accelerating mana, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient threats. Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst disrupt opponents' mana bases, while Avenging Hunter and Generous Ent provide additional damage output. The inclusion of Reclaiming Vines offers flexibility in dealing with problematic artifacts or enchantments. With a focus on speed and efficiency, this deck aims to apply pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient creatures and quickly build a board presence. By utilizing cheap creatures such as Thraben Inspector and Squadron Hawk, as well as spells like Guardians' Pledge and Battle Screech, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Additionally, cards like Journey to Nowhere and Prismatic Strands provide removal and protection to keep the aggressive strategy going.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and draining the opponent's resources through the use of removal spells like Cast Down and Defile, as well as recurring Pestilence to wear down the opponent's life total. The deck also includes card draw and token generation with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Lembas, and gains life through cards like Radiant Fountain to sustain the use of Pestilence. It also utilizes the bounce lands Orzhov Basilica for mana efficiency and value. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a victory through attrition.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent. With a mix of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fiery Temper, along with creatures like Kitchen Imp and Voldaren Epicure, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while using Alms of the Vein and Vampire's Kiss to gain life and maintain resources. The deck also includes cards like Deadly Dispute and Fodder Tosser to generate card advantage and keep up the tempo. With a low curve and aggressive playstyle, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive playstyle, utilizing low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By playing cards like Lightning Bolt, Goblin Bushwhacker, and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and finish the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. Additionally, cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Grenade provide additional reach and burst damage potential. The inclusion of cards like Great Furnace and Implement of Combustion also helps to support the aggro strategy by providing efficient mana sources and additional burn damage.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Wild Growth, Utopia Sprawl, and Arbor Elf, in order to play big aggressive creatures like Avenging Hunter, Annoyed Altisaur, and Boarding Party. By destroying opponent's lands with Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst, the deck aims to disrupt their game plan while continuing to apply pressure. Skred provides removal for threats, while Llanowar Visionary helps with card draw and mana fixing. The deck ultimately seeks to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and efficient ramping.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, while also disrupting the opponent's resources with Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst. Avenging Hunter and Boarding Party provide early aggression, while Annoyed Altisaur and Generous Ent offer large threats in the mid-late game. Llanowar Visionary helps with card draw and mana fixing, while Relic of Progenitus disrupts graveyard strategies. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast and efficient creatures, backed up by versatile removal and mana acceleration.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly flood the board with low-cost artifact creatures and utilize affinity cards to minimize the cost of spells. By efficiently playing artifacts, the deck can quickly amass resources and overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays. The deck also includes removal and burn spells to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. Through a combination of card advantage and aggressive plays, this deck aims to outpace and outvalue opponents in a fast-paced Pauper 1 vs. 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of Goblins and sacrifice effects to generate value and card advantage. By sacrificing creatures like Putrid Goblin and Ichor Wellspring, the deck can draw cards, generate mana, and find key combo pieces like Skirk Prospector and Dark-Dweller Oracle. The deck also utilizes recursion effects like Unearth to bring creatures back from the graveyard and continue the combo. With the addition of cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering, the deck can also disrupt the opponent's game plan while furthering its own strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to aggressively play low-cost creatures and spells, using them to consistently deal damage to the opponent while quickly overwhelming them. The focus is on fast, efficient creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Goblin Tomb Raider, supported by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to close out the game. The use of artifacts like Implement of Combustion and Experimental Synthesizer helps to supplement the aggressive strategy, making this deck a relentless force in the Pauper format.
